name: portal-petronect-comportamento-usuario
description: Prototype to capture, store and analyze supplier behavior on the Petronect Portal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w petronect-behavior-backend" "npm run dev -w petronect-behavior-frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w petronect-behavior-frontend && npm run lint -w petronect-behavior-backend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint -w petronect-behavior-frontend -- --fix && npm run lint -w petronect-behavior-backend -- --fix
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w petronect-behavior-frontend && npm run typecheck -w petronect-behavior-backend
